resources.title: Capstone Acceptance Rubric
resources.description: The scored, checkable version of Lesson 1's Definition of Done — 100 points across business requirements, data modeling, security, automation, data/reporting, troubleshooting, deployment readiness, and documentation, with real in-org verification steps and a required 90-point pass bar.

resources.title: Cascade Security Model Reference
resources.description: Lesson 4's complete role hierarchy, five-profile table, OWD settings, and all three sharing rules, each with the specific access gap it closes — the ground truth to implement against in Lesson 11 and to score Category 3 of the rubric.

resources.title: Security Access Troubleshooting Checklist
resources.description: The real layered evaluation order (object permissions → field-level security → OWD → role hierarchy → sharing rules → restriction rules) for diagnosing any "can/can't see or edit this" report, plus the permission-sets-are-additive gotcha and why FLS, not OWD, is almost always the cause of "can see the record but not one field."

resources.title: Handoff Document Template
resources.description: Lesson 18's exact eight-section structure as a fill-in template, plus the four-line format every Flow, validation rule, and approval process needs in the automation inventory section.
